in_marathi.name: Khetaram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Field of Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khetaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Khet’ meaning ‘field’ and ‘Rama’ meaning ‘Rama’. It is believed to be a name of Lord Rama. This name signifies the devotion towards Lord Rama and his blessings in one's life.
